title: 第5章 赐予奖励第6章 修炼剑道真解
slug: 签到大帝修为开局收下禁忌剑体
content_zh:
秦天阳满意地点点头，随后从系统空间取出之前领取的奖励。
他左手拿着一枚玉简，右手拿着一把长剑。
玉简表面刻着四个字——剑道真解。
当陆玄合直视这四个字时，仿佛被吸引住了心神。
眼前景象突然变换，他发现自己好像来到了星空中，星空深处繁星点点，星河闪烁，点缀着寂静、幽深的宇宙。
忽然！
剑道真解四个大字映入眼帘，渐渐地，陆玄合发现这四个字的每一笔每一划都变成了一柄柄凌厉无比的剑，在星空中仿佛遵循着某种道的痕迹，飞舞旋转着，神秘莫测，蕴涵着一股玄妙。
正当他准备仔细观察时，这些剑宛如灵动的舞者，进一步排列组合，渐渐形成了四把巨大无比的剑。
古老！
神秘！
这是陆玄合对这四把剑的第一印象，它们仿佛是四把从开天辟地就存在的神剑，散发着令人心悸的威严。
他如痴如醉地观察着，仿佛色中饿鬼看见四位绝世美女般，沉迷于这四把神剑无可自拔，除此之外，这世间没有什么东西能吸引他的注意力。
星空中岁月流转，永恒寂静！
一年。
百年。
千万年。
仿佛无尽岁月过去，四把神剑开始有所变化了。
砰！
四把神剑在某种力量的牵引下，逐渐靠近，开始融合。
其声势惊天动地，搅得星河震颤，宇宙动荡。

最后渐渐归于平静。
最终，呈现在陆玄合眼前的是一把普普通通的铁剑，与之前那四把神剑截然不同。
若是有人拿一把世俗界凡人铁匠打造的剑与之比较，会发现二者并无区别。
但这只是表象罢了，倘若仔细观察，会发现剑身之上有神秘道韵流转不断。
神物天成，华光内敛，返璞归真。
陆玄合正欲仔细探查一番时，这把铁剑自己动了起来。
仿佛有人握住它一般，朝着星空深处斩出一剑。
轰！
星空深处，星河破碎，无数繁星化为尘埃。
末日之景在陆玄合眼前上演，他如遭雷击般惊呆了，身体僵硬得如同雕塑，愣在原地一动不动。
尚未从震惊中回过神来，那铁剑便如闪电般再次斩出一剑。
眼前的景象，天崩地裂已不足以形容，仿佛是世界末日的降临，他看到了此生之前从未目睹过的震撼景象。
无边无尽的宇宙被这把“普通”
的铁剑劈开了，宇宙之外的混沌之气涌入裂缝处，所到之处一切化为混沌，这片宇宙似乎要回归混沌状态。
正当陆玄合震惊于此景时，那铁剑竟然朝他斩出一剑，一道剑光爆射而出，带着无可阻挡的气势直逼他而来。
他想抵挡，却发现自己动弹不得，只能绝望地闭上双眼，静待死亡到来。
然而，等了许久，臆想中死亡并未到来，陆玄合睁开双眼，发现自己还活着。
此刻自己正身处大殿之中，自己的师尊秦天阳正笑嘻嘻地看着自己，仿佛什么也没发生。
玉简静静地躺在秦天阳手中，其上面的剑道真解四个字普通无比。
之前经历的一切犹如梦境一般，太过于真实。

“怎么？不会傻了吧？”
秦天阳拍了拍他的肩。
“师尊，我刚刚好像经历了一次幻境，在幻境中我来到了星空中，看到了恐怖的景象：星河破碎，宇宙破灭。
最后我本以为自己也要死了，无法挣扎，只能闭上眼睛等死。”
“没成想再次睁开眼睛，发现自己仍然身处大殿之中，您正看着我，一切都没变。”
content_en:
Qin Tianyang nodded with satisfaction, and then took out the previously received reward from the system space.
He holds a jade slip in his left hand and a long sword in his right hand.
Four words are engraved on the surface of the jade slip - the true solution to the way of swordsmanship.
When Lu Xuanhe looked directly at these four words, his mind seemed to be attracted.
The scene in front of him suddenly changed, and he found that he seemed to be in the starry sky. There were stars in the depths of the starry sky, and the stars were twinkling, dotted with the silent and deep universe.
suddenly!
The four characters "True Explanation of Sword Dao" came into view. Gradually, Lu Xuanhe discovered that every stroke of these four characters turned into an extremely sharp sword. It seemed to follow the traces of some kind of Tao in the starry sky, flying and rotating, mysterious and unpredictable, and containing a mystery.
Just as he was about to take a closer look, these swords were further arranged and combined like agile dancers, gradually forming four huge swords.
ancient!
mystery!
This was Lu Xuanhe's first impression of these four swords. They seemed to be four divine swords that had existed since the beginning of the world, exuding a heart-stopping majesty.
He observed with fascination, as if a hungry ghost in lust saw four peerless beauties, obsessed with these four divine swords. Apart from that, nothing in this world could attract his attention.
The years pass by in the starry sky, and there is eternal silence!
One year.
century.
Millions of years.
As if endless years had passed, the four divine swords began to change.
Bang!
Drawn by some kind of force, the four divine swords gradually came closer and began to merge.
Its momentum was earth-shattering, causing the stars and rivers to tremble and the universe to tremble.
Finally, it gradually calmed down.
In the end, what appeared in front of Lu Xuanhe was an ordinary iron sword, which was completely different from the four divine swords before.
If someone were to compare a sword made by a mortal blacksmith in the secular world, they would find that there is no difference between the two.
But this is just an appearance. If you observe carefully, you will find that there is a mysterious Taoist charm flowing continuously on the sword body.
Divine things are made in nature, the brilliance is restrained, and the original nature is restored.
When Lu Xuanhe was about to investigate carefully, the iron sword started to move on its own.
As if someone was holding it, he slashed a sword towards the depths of the starry sky.
boom!
Deep in the starry sky, the galaxy is broken, and countless stars turn into dust.
The scene of doomsday unfolded before Lu Xuanhe's eyes. He was stunned as if struck by lightning. His body was as stiff as a sculpture, and he stood motionless in place.
Before he could recover from the shock, the iron sword struck out again like lightning.
The scene in front of him was beyond description. It seemed like the end of the world was coming. He saw a shocking scene that he had never seen before in his life.
The boundless universe is blocked by this "ordinary"
The iron sword split open, and the chaotic energy from outside the universe poured into the crack. Everything turned into chaos wherever it went, and the universe seemed to be returning to a state of chaos.
Just when Lu Xuanhe was shocked by this scene, the iron sword actually slashed at him, and a sword light burst out, approaching him with an unstoppable momentum.
He wanted to resist, but found that he could not move. He could only close his eyes in despair and wait for death to come.
However, after waiting for a long time, the death he imagined had not come. Lu Xuanhe opened his eyes and found that he was still alive.
At this moment, he was in the main hall, and his master Qin Tianyang was looking at him with a smile, as if nothing had happened.
The jade slip lay quietly in Qin Tianyang's hand, and the four words "True Explanation of Kendo" on it were extremely ordinary.
Everything I experienced before was like a dream, too real.
"What? You're not stupid, are you?"
Qin Tianyang patted his shoulder.
"Master, I just seemed to have experienced an illusion. In the illusion, I came to the starry sky and saw a terrifying scene: the galaxy was shattered and the universe was shattered.
In the end, I thought I was going to die too. I couldn't struggle, so I could only close my eyes and wait for death. "
"Unexpectedly, I opened my eyes again and found that I was still in the main hall., you are looking at me, nothing has changed. "
